segments.text: GTA Six just made three point seven nine billion dollars. In one day.
Take-Two says it's the biggest entertainment launch in history. Bigger than any game, any movie, any album.

chart.title: DAY-ONE / OPENING RECORDS
chart.source: Take-Two; Disney via NPR. Company retail estimates.

segments.text: GTA Five made eight hundred million on day one. Avengers Endgame made one point two billion in its whole opening weekend. GTA Six made more than three times that.
Thirty-two point five million copies were sold before it even launched.
And critics gave it a ninety-nine on Metacritic, tying the highest score ever.

segments.why: Retail sales. Sony, Microsoft and stores take a cut
segments.text: But does Rockstar keep all of it? Fake. That's retail sales. Sony, Microsoft and stores take a cut.
Thirteen years of waiting. Was it worth it? Tell us in the comments.
